name: Imaginary heart
source:
A boy wakes up in an odd world filled with cartoonish creatures. He has to find a girl and tell her something for some reason. But why? You guide him and choose any decisions that could impact him or unlock as to what is happening.

[From [url=https://notaghost01.itch.io/imaginary-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩在一个充满卡通生物的奇怪世界中醒来。由于某种原因，他必须找到一个女孩并告诉她一些事情。但为什么？你引导他并选择任何可能影响他或了解正在发生的事情的决定。

[来自[url=https://notaghost01.itch.io/imaginary-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
